LESSON: LANGUAGE USE 10.3.1 SIMPLE PREPOSITIONS (IN, ON, UNDER, BETWEEN, BEHIND, IN FRONT, INSIDE, OUTSIDE)

Grade: SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade one
Subject: ENGLISH LANGUAGE ACTIVITIES
Strand: Strand 10
Topic 10.3: Language use 10.3.1 Simple prepositions (in, on, under, between, behind, in front, inside, outside)
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Language use 10.3.1 Simple prepositions (in, on, under, between, behind, in front, inside, outside), part of Strand 10 in SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade one ENGLISH LANGUAGE ACTIVITIES.

Key inquiry question: How do we tell where objects are?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Language use 10.3.1 Simple prepositions (in, on, under, between, behind, in front, inside, outside) together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
Digital literacy: A learner plays digital games based on prepositions on digital devices with assistive technology.

Values:
• Unity: Cooperation is developed as learners collaborate and take up assigned roles games.

• Social justice: Fairness is enhanced learners accord each other equal opportunities in sharing roles.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
Environmental awareness. A learner identifies object in their surroundings.

Links to other Learning Areas:
Learner applies knowledge of prepositions to the learning of Kiswahili Language activities, Environmental Education.

Suggested learning resources

• Textbooks in print and in braille

• Digital games

• Digital devices with assistive technology
